subject: Onboarding to OneTrust & ephemeral credentialing for SOC 2 evidence
messages:
From: Jamie Liu <j.liu@skywardhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@skywardhealth.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: OneTrust onboarding + ephemeral creds for SOC 2 evidence

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the quick chat yesterday. We need to get Redwood set up in our OneTrust vendor portal so our security ops team can pull your SOC 2 report and CAIQ. A couple of asks from our side: 

- Provision a primary portal contact and a backup (name + email).
- Provide short-lived SFTP or temporary credentials (we prefer ephemeral keys) for automated evidence ingestion (S3 access is not permitted for our environment).
- Upload a copy of SOC 2 Type II 2026 and a brief summary of your evidence rotation plan.

Can you confirm ownership and an ETA? If there are any compliance contacts (security@redwood.com) please loop them in.

Thanks,
Jamie Liu
Security Operations
Skyward Health

[attachment: soc2-report-2026.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>

Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: OneTrust onboarding + ephemeral creds for SOC 2 evidence

Hi Jamie — thanks for the clear checklist. Confirming Redwood can onboard to OneTrust and provide ephemeral access for ingestion. High-level plan: 

1) Portal contacts: I will be the primary contact (sean_gallagher@redwood.com). Mina will be backup for evidence coordination.
2) Ephemeral credentials: our security team prefers signed, time-limited SFTP keys or a short-lived SFTP user with rotation hooks. We cannot supply S3 keys for this integration.
3) Evidence: attaching SOC 2 report and a short rotation plan doc; we will also provide a CAIQ export via the portal.

Next steps for us:
- Mina will draft the SSH key rotation / puppet for ephemeral creds and share the manifest.
- Karthik will provision the portal user account and confirm the OneTrust organization slug.

ETA: portal account and initial creds by Wed 17 Mar EOD PST, evidence copy attached now.

Sean
Director, Commercial
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: OneTrust onboarding + ephemeral creds for SOC 2 evidence

Hi Jamie — forwarding the rotation plan and the ephemeral key approach we propose. Key points: 

- We will create a short-lived SFTP account with passwordless SSH using certificate signing (SSH certs valid for 24 hours).
- Automated rotation: certs signed by our internal CA; we will push cert expiry metadata to your ingestion system when the job runs.
- Audit trail: every connection is logged and we will provide access logs for a rolling 90-day window.
- Fallback: if SFTP is incompatible we can provide a signed, one-time URL mechanism for the specific evidence bundle.

Attachment: ssh-key-rotation-plan.md

Mina H.
Security Engineer, Red Team
Redwood Inference

Thanks — that layout is helpful. A couple quick follow-ups before we onboard: 

- Can you confirm the account username we should add in OneTrust (exact email)?
- Our portal automation requires a single SSH host key fingerprint for allowlisting. Can you provide the fingerprint for the cert-issuing host?
- Any constraints on filenames or path structure for the ingestion job (we can map whatever you produce, but we prefer YYYYMMDD_bundle.zip).

If you can send those three items I’ll open the portal request and add Redwood as a vendor. We’re aiming to complete onboarding by next Tue and start nightly pulls the following week.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Jamie
